topic: Check terms and region before joining
hook: Before you sign up anywhere, check two boring things.

scenes.narration: GoMining states its products and features are subject to eligibility and its terms.
They are also subject to regional availability, so what you see may differ by country.
Read both before you decide anything. That is true for any platform, not just this one.

cta: What do you check first? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Before You Join Any Mining Platform: Check This
description_body: Eligibility, terms and regional availability can change what is on offer.
